# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---|---|
| latest | yes |

Only the most recent published image tag receives security fixes. Pin to a specific version tag and watch the changelog for updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/x10send/influxdb-mcp-server/security/advisories/new) to report security issues. Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities.

Expect an acknowledgement within 48 hours and a fix or mitigation plan within 14 days for confirmed issues.
